gaps.explanation: p9 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints Electric Fund, Water Fund, Sewer Fund and Landfill Fund columns; no utility schedule is in the trim, so detail has no business-type lines. JSON receipts = Charges for services + Other revenue + Interest income + Grant income. Electric 4,373,174 + 105,783 + 6,205 = 4,485,162; Water 473,991 + 12,450 + 898 + 85,119 = 572,458; Sewer 324,060 + 1,925 + 239,464 = 565,449; Landfill 683,238 + 9,527 = 692,765. 0 + 4,485,162 + 572,458 + 565,449 + 692,765 = 6,315,834 = statement total. (Governmental gaps were explained by the first pass and are not repeated here.)
